entry.prompt: Twisted thorn tree: a gnarled trunk twisting as it rises, carrying a tall ragged crown of four fused chunky clumps bristling with big hooked thorns, crown taller than wide. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism that reads from above. Solid closed volumes, thick spikes only, no leaves, no thin twigs, hard edges, flat faces. One tree about 3 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no base plate, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Trunk: dark red-brown bark (#4A2E28) with ash-grey highlights (#76675F). Thorn clumps: deep oxblood red (#6E2420) darkening to near black at the base (#2E1E1C), with glowing ember-orange tips and cracks (#F07A2E) as the only bright accents. No leaves, no flames, no text or logos.
